visual_action: A sit-down interview between Donald Trump and an interviewer, Dasha Burns. They are seated opposite each other in armchairs in an indoor setting. The camera cuts between a close-up on Trump and a wider two-shot.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: Visibly identified on screen, speaking, and is the subject of the video's framing text.

cast.name: Dasha Burns
cast.evidence: Shown interviewing Trump. Her name appears on screen in the text 'with Dasha Burns'.

cast.name: POLITICO
cast.evidence: The POLITICO logo is displayed in the upper right corner of the interview footage.

on_screen_text.text: Trump on the price of gifts going up: "Don't be dramatic"

spoken_summary: An interviewer begins to ask Donald Trump about people buying holiday presents and planning their budgets. Trump interrupts her, saying, "Look, don't be dramatic." He repeats himself when she tries to continue, dismissing her point about people planning their budgets for the next year.
audio_music: The audio consists solely of the spoken dialogue from the interview. There is no music or other sound design.
editing_pacing: The video uses simple cuts between a medium shot of the two speakers and a close-up of Donald Trump. Dynamic, yellow, capitalized text captions appear on screen, synchronized with the speech.
central_claim: Donald Trump dismisses concerns about the rising cost of gifts and its impact on people's holiday budgets as being 'dramatic'.
intended_effect: To portray Donald Trump as out of touch with and dismissive of the financial struggles of ordinary people.
